### Symplectic Integrators

Symplectic integrators are numerical methods used to solve differential equations. They maintain the phase space structure of the system by preserving the symplectic properties of the underlying Hamiltonian flow. This means that the time evolution preserves the Poisson bracket relations between the coordinates
